name: Watch Ideas
description: Link-free film and TV recommendation search for guest-facing agents, plus a guard that keeps them off page-fetching tools.

uiHints.label: Watch Ideas
uiHints.help: Gives a guest-facing agent a film/TV recommendation search (find_watch_ideas), an AniList anime lookup (find_anime), and web_fetch limited to pages its own searches returned. Queries with URLs, domains, IPs, search operators or nothing about film/TV are refused. Grant the tools per agent under tools.allow.

agents.label: Guarded agents
agents.help: Agent ids whose web_fetch is limited to their own search results, and who are refused web_search, x_search and browser tools outright, whatever their allowlist says. Default: concierge (Milo).

count.label: Results per search
count.help: How many results one search returns, 1-8.
